description:
"Shall we join them?"

Reiji, accompanied by his wife Kanade and their close friends Kosuke and Asuka, had visited the inn for vacation. On the first day, during dinner, a heated argument broke out between the two couples, and Asuka dragged Reiji away to her room. But from inside, he could hear his wife Kanade's restless sighs...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: The complete edition with explicit scenes was distributed web via Comic Festa Anime Zone. The on-air version was broadcasted on Tokyo MX and BS11.
